reason: Displays per-turn and cumulative input/output token usage, cache statistics, thinking-token markers, and step details in the DeepSeek Harness web conversation UI using client-side session data.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的助手回复下方显示每轮及会话累计的词元用量、缓存命中率和相关明细。
summaries.en: Displays per-turn and cumulative token usage, cache hit rates, and related details beneath assistant replies in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads token-usage data from the DeepSeek Harness session snapshot
Aggregates per-turn and session token metrics
Displays usage badges and hover details in the web conversation UI
Supports configurable display options and zh/en labels
